title: Supply-Chain Widget: Raw innerHTML Sink vs Trusted Types + CSP Nonce
description: Compare an unguarded third-party widget writing raw HTML and reading unvalidated postMessage payloads against a TrustedHTML-enforced boundary.

before.label: Unguarded Widget Sink + Unsafe CSP
before.previewNote: A compromised CDN script injects an inline event handler into innerHTML and pollutes Object.prototype.isAdmin to exfiltrate session tokens.

after.label: Trusted Types + Nonce CSP + Schema Gate
after.previewNote: Raw string assignments to innerHTML throw TypeError, inline scripts fail nonce verification, and Object.hasOwn blocks prototype gadgets.
